determinism.method: double-run byte-compare of report.md+data.json replaying latest-edition pins for BQ-13

review_history.summary: Plan-conformant and deterministic on current pins; RT-13.1 margin/provenance disclosure implemented. Main risk: direction words in the verdict are literals, not branches - the 'months before our launch' claim inverts when the data anchor advances past mid-2026.

findings.summary: Headline+bullet hardcode 'months before our launch'; abs() hides sign - inverts on next 510(k) anchor advance
findings.disposition: fix: branch before/after on sign of margin; drop abs()

findings.summary: hw_edge_days sign unhandled; 'by only N days'/'RAZOR-THIN' emitted regardless of sign or magnitude
findings.disposition: fix: branch on sign; fragility qualifier only under smallness threshold

findings.summary: 'Every documented row reads no' bullet unconditional - false and self-contradicting in the RUNWAY-MOOT branch
findings.disposition: fix: conditionalize on shipping

findings.summary: max() over decision_date raises on a snapshot with zero dated rows (also bq_15/17)
findings.disposition: accept: snapshot contract guarantees dated rows; loud crash beats silent wrong anchor

determinism.method: double-run byte-compare of report.md+data.json replaying latest-edition pins for BQ-06, BQ-12, BQ-18, BQ-19, BQ-23, BQ-24, BQ-25, BQ-26, BQ-27

review_history.summary: Shared helpers sound (median/dedupe/windows/determinism verified; loud pin errors); BQ-26 refit commitments all implemented; findings are latent hazards and literal-fact rot risks, none invalidates a current published number.

findings.summary: helper/pct: thresholds compared on rounded rates (bq24 pause, bq18 breach, bq26 verdicts) — knife-edge risk
findings.disposition: fix: compare unrounded, round only at render

findings.summary: helper/module_dispatch: ModuleNotFoundError inside an existing bq module swallowed as 'no computation'
findings.disposition: fix: re-raise unless e.name is the dispatched module

findings.summary: helper/evaluate_expectations: computed results with unknown E-ids silently dropped
findings.disposition: fix: loud check on unknown result ids

findings.summary: helper/pct: zero denominator renders 0.0 not n/a
findings.disposition: accept: no caller stratum currently empties; revisit if one can

findings.summary: helper/expectations_section: unescaped pipes in catalog text break markdown tables
findings.disposition: accept: catalog-controlled input

findings.summary: bq06: 'fastest frequent filer' computed from top_n-truncated set; exact today by coincidence (6 of 15 >=2)
findings.disposition: fix: filter >=2 clearances before top_n

findings.summary: bq06: 'since 2021' scope literal rides on dataset acquisition scope (true vs pin)
findings.disposition: accept: plan-stated dataset scope

findings.summary: bq18: current window 91d inclusive vs prior 90d — slight upward bias on 130% rising test; bq12 label same +1d
findings.disposition: fix: half-open windows

findings.summary: bq18: window-trend derivation string hardcodes '90-day' instead of window param
findings.disposition: fix: interpolate the param

findings.summary: bq19: BLOCKED/'not yet quantified' headline is a literal; rate_ready computed but unused - rots if A-001 quantifies
findings.disposition: fix: branch headline on rate_ready; fail loud when True

findings.summary: bq19: unmatched manufacturer names .title()-cased; plan says 'stay raw'
findings.disposition: accept: cosmetic, note for plan/code sync

findings.summary: bq23: E-23.1 95% target judged by 100%-completion projection; target_pct unused in math (conservative)
findings.disposition: accept: plan defines projection as remaining/rate

findings.summary: bq24/25/26: complement status sets (!= scheduled / not in COMPLETED) absorb vocabulary drift, diluting the pause trigger
findings.disposition: fix: assert observed statuses subset of known vocabulary

findings.summary: bq26: F26-2 residual — R1 mitigation lacks remote-path-rollback caveat (moot while convertible=0)
findings.disposition: fix: one clause at next re-answer

findings.summary: bq27: '(all on 2.9.x line)' narrated string-literal fact — true vs both pins, rots on refresh
findings.disposition: fix: compute the qualifier from the data

findings.summary: bq27: behind_map.get(fw,0) counts unmapped firmware as current — optimistic default on safety-framed metric
findings.disposition: fix: surface or fail on unmapped versions

findings.summary: bq24/06/27/25: fragile lines.insert(-N) tail arithmetic + unused assume_path var — cosmetic
findings.disposition: accept: fold into next touch
